title: 2-D Mean
text: Find 2-D mean of input array, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Reset port} sets Reset event; {Running mean}, {Find the mean value over} sets the dimension along which mean is computed Entire, {Dimension} sets the custom dimension, {Enable ROI processing} sets the compute mean value within ROI, {ROI type} sets the type of ROI, {ROI portion to process} sets the portion of ROI for which to compute mean Entire, {Output} sets the compute individual or universal mean for ROIs Individual statistics for each, {Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds} enables flag output port, {Output flag indicating if input label numbers are valid} enables flag output port and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: I
ports.summary: Input array vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Mean value of input scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset event None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Find the mean value over
params.values: Dimension along which mean is computed Entire input (default) | Each row | Each column | Specified dimension

params.name: Enable ROI processing
params.values: Compute mean value within ROI off (default) | on

params.name: ROI type
params.values: Type of ROI Rectangles (default) | Lines | Label matrix | Binary mask

params.name: ROI portion to process
params.values: Portion of ROI for which to compute mean Entire ROI (default) | ROI perimeter

params.name: Output
params.values: Compute individual or universal mean for ROIs Individual statistics for each ROI (default) | Single statistic for all ROIs

params.name: Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds
params.values: Enable flag output port off (default) | on

params.name: Output flag indicating if input label numbers are valid
params.values: Enable flag output port off (default) | on

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
